patch_list: Makes the dark theme pure black: background, cards and surfaces become #000000 instead of the stock #111111 / #222222 grays.

Blocks Firebase / Google Analytics events, Crashlytics, Sessions, In-App Messaging and FCM delivery metrics, and removes the Advertising ID and AdServices attribution permissions. Sign-in, Remote Config and push keep working.
Removes "Send Logs to Developer" from Settings, stops the app from collecting its in-memory log buffer, and makes the log export a no-op.

Removes the "Sign in with Google" button everywhere it appears. The app keeps working with its anonymous account; anything that needs a Google account (publishing under your name, synced collections) is no longer reachable.
Removes Follow Us, Email Us, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy from Settings. Community and Version stay.
Unlocks SigStick Premium client-side: no ads, 60 stickers per pack, unlimited pack creation and the premium editor features.
